name: NeRF-style Volume Rendering Integrator
definition: A simplified NeRF-style integrator that accumulates emission along a ray through a medium, backed by a dense grid instead of a neural network, with no direction-dependent emission.
summary: A simplified NeRF-style integrator that accumulates emission along a ray using a dense grid instead of a neural network, explicitly handling primal and dual modes for gradient computation in inverse rendering.
